footer.tagline: One fitness passport for every city. Members book any partner gym in local currency. Owners fill quiet hours without building their own tech.

hero.title: One pass. <accent>Every gym</accent> on the planet.
hero.lead: Your fitness passport. Land in any city, see which gyms are quiet, book a pass in local currency and walk in with a QR. Every visit adds a stamp.

departures.title: Wherever you land, your pass already works.
departures.lead: Prices stay in each city’s own currency. Times, distances and numbers follow your region.

orbit.title: Gyms around you, <accent>not in a list</accent>
orbit.lead: Closer gyms sit nearer the centre. Each ring fills with how busy it is right now, so the quiet one is easy to spot.

passportSection.title: Every workout leaves <accent>a stamp</accent>
passportSection.lead: Your history goes everywhere with you. One profile, one streak and one QR for every partner gym on the planet.

stamp.title: A stamp per city
stamp.text: Check in once and the city lands in your passport for good.

streak.title: Streaks that travel
streak.text: Your weekly streak keeps counting in any city, on any pass.

perks.title: Perks for regulars
perks.text: Partner gyms reward full passports with free sessions and gear.

pulse.title: Skip the queue for <accent>the squat rack</accent>
pulse.lead: Fit Planet shows how busy a gym is before you leave home, wherever home is this week.

live.title: Live crowd
live.text: Every gym reports how full it is as members check in.

forecast.title: Hourly forecast
forecast.text: See the quiet windows for today in the gym’s own time zone.

alerts.title: Quiet alerts
alerts.text: Get a nudge when your favourite gym drops below half full.

twoSides.title: Where people who train meet the gyms that <accent>want them</accent>
twoSides.lead: Fit Planet is a two-sided marketplace. Members get freedom and transparency. Gyms get demand, tools and data they never had.

members.title: Train anywhere, pay only for what you use.

how.title: From couch to squat rack in <accent>four steps</accent>
how.lead: We removed every step that made joining a gym painful. What is left takes about a minute.

search.title: Search for gyms
search.text: Pick a city or use your location. Filter by price, amenities, rating and how busy it is right now.

choose.title: Choose your pass
choose.text: Day, week or monthly. Compare what each gym offers and pick what fits your week, not a year-long contract.

pay.title: Book and pay online
pay.text: Secure checkout with instant confirmation. Add-ons like a trainer session or locker in one tap.

train.title: Show your QR and train
train.text: Your pass lives in the app. The gym scans it at the door and you are in. That is the whole process.

owners.title: Run your gym like a <accent>modern business</accent>
owners.lead: Most gyms still run on WhatsApp and paper registers. Fit Planet Studio brings bookings, check-ins, pricing and revenue into one place, and sends you new members.

noSoftware.title: No software hassle
noSoftware.text: A polished listing and booking flow without building a website or app.

occupancy.title: Live occupancy
occupancy.text: See how full the floor is from real check-ins, on your phone.

pricing.title: Flexible pricing
pricing.text: Day, week and monthly passes, paid online or at the desk.

checkins.title: QR check-ins
checkins.text: Scan and verify members instantly. No paper registers.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: Bookings, revenue, peak hours and pass mix at a glance.

reviews.title: Reviews and replies
reviews.text: Verified reviews from real visits, and your replies right under them.

stories.title: Early members and gyms, <accent>in their words</accent>
